features.note: Neutral and engineering-section captures show the front public threshold, central spine, exactly eight labeled auditorium rooms in the 2/4/2 family distribution, and a distinct rear service band. The roof-service engineering close-up visibly keeps the rear corridor separate from room enclosures and shows corridor-facing doors.

The family-master architecture/engineering pair and the isolated overhead view show three geometry-only families with visibly different 7/5/3 tier lengths, side-aisle gaps, cross-circulation breaks, wheelchair voids, screen-wall frames, projection recesses, and distinct corridor/emergency openings. These cues are present but close to the minimum readable scale.

Facade and neutral architecture captures show attached entrance glazing, lobby/ticket band, dominant concession counter, checkpoint/access lane and kitchen volume as a continuous public sequence. The kitchen pair adds a visibly seated hood/extract root and the circulation remains open between systems.

Complete-network and RS-485-master evidence visibly preserve four UC-origin trunks, fourteen TC-ending drops, junction contacts, wall-sleeve crossings and tray backing. UG67 architecture shows the real-scale wall-mounted body with both antenna roots seated on top collars; UG67 engineering shows its Ethernet attachment and wireless media without a false UC-to-UG67 physical tube. The external router/cloud/Niagara/client chain remains ordered and connected.

Matched neutral, section, kitchen, auditorium, technical, UG67, family and network pairs retain the same building geometry while changing from opaque architectural context to translucent/cutaway engineering context with devices and media exposed.

important_features.note: Human proxies, full-height doors, counters, auditorium geometry and the close UG67 view establish a coherent scale ladder without inflating the small gateway.
At this structural gate the flat evidence still separates bright public geometry from dark corridor/auditorium volumes, but authored cinema lighting hierarchy is intentionally not yet developed.

RS-485 trunks/drops are visibly carried by trays through junctions and sleeves, while the roof-service pair shows two separate mains seated through owned orange collars into overlapping gray plenum sockets; the kitchen extract root is also visibly attached.

defects: The family-master evidence proves the three tier grammars, but its low oblique framing makes the wheelchair void and cross-aisle breaks subtle rather than immediately countable.

The technical-architecture capture is too tightly cropped and reads as an abstract overhead slice; rear-room and corridor context is supplied more clearly by the roof-service engineering capture instead.
Large labels overlap some facade and complete-network geometry, reducing local readability even though counts and connectivity remain recoverable across the supplemental views.
corrections: For later presentation gates, add a slightly higher family-master oblique that keeps all three complete tier footprints, cross aisles and wheelchair voids simultaneously visible without adding surface detail.
Reframe the technical architecture preset to include the full rear service strip, separating wall and corridor-facing door row in one view.
Offset large zone and room labels away from the facade and network lines while preserving their current associations.
